name: Isometric
tagline: Line-art isometric illustrations in white and gray, with a touch of orange.
description: Technical isometric drawings for product sites and docs: thin hairline outlines, white and light-gray faces lit from the top-left, faint construction lines and grids, small mono labels, and orange used only as an accent. Every illustration ships in light and dark, and is built from a small drawing kit that agents can use to draw new ones in the same family.
